mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_chunk_embeddings ( chunk_id, embedding_model, vector_store, vector_point_id, content_hash, status, embedded_at, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{chunkId}, #{model}, #{vectorStore}, #{vectorPointId}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, NOW(), #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_point_id = VALUES(vector_point_id), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), status = VALUES(status), embedded_at = VALUES(embedded_at), last_error_message = VALUES(last_error_message)
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_documents doc SET import_status = 'INDEXED', last_error_message = NULL, imported_at = NOW() WHERE doc.document_type = #{documentType} AND doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rag_document_chunks c LEFT JOIN rag_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE c.document_id = doc.document_id AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND AND ( e.chunk_id IS NULL OR e.status != 'INDEXED' OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '') ) )

UPDATE rag_chunk_embeddings e JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN rag_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id SET e.status = 'FAILED', e.last_error_message = 'Recovered stale BATCH_SUBMITTED without active batch job.', e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'BATCH_SUBMITTED' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.embedded_at, NOW()) >= #{staleMinutes} AND (#{documentType} = '' OR doc.document_type = #{documentType}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc JOIN semantic_batch_jobs bj ON bj.batch_job_id = bjc.batch_job_id WHERE bjc.chunk_id = e.chunk_id AND bj.target = doc.document_type AND bj.status IN ('validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing') )
